description: Ontology for a troubleshooting knowledge graph of a technical asset, built from its manuals for diagnosis by a maintenance agent: from what is observed to the possible causes, the checks that tell them apart and the actions on the components involved.
design_principles: Center the ontology on troubleshooting rather than full product modeling.
Separate observed symptoms from underlying failure modes.
Represent corrective actions as operational remediation steps.
Keep the schema minimal, connected, and non-redundant.
Store provenance as node attributes when sufficient for the application.
Connect knowledge through shared components: faults, symptoms and actions point to the part they concern, and parts to the assembly they belong to.
State absence instead of inventing a bridge: a remedy given without a named cause is linked directly to the symptom or code, and a cause without a remedy says so.

nodes.name: Asset
nodes.description: The product, machine, robot, cobot, controller, or other technical asset that is the subject of troubleshooting knowledge.

nodes.name: Component
nodes.description: A physical or software component or subsystem of the asset involved in troubleshooting.

properties.name: part_number
properties.description: Part number printed in the manual.

properties.name: source_reference
properties.description: Page and section of the manual where the item is written.

nodes.name: Symptom
nodes.description: An observed issue, anomaly, or visible manifestation detected by the user or system.

properties.name: diagnosis_status
properties.description: 'not_stated' when the manual names neither a cause nor a remedy for the symptom.

properties.name: source_reference
properties.description: Page and section of the manual where the item is written.

nodes.name: FailureMode
nodes.description: The underlying technical cause or failure mechanism that may explain one or more symptoms.

properties.name: remedy_status
properties.description: 'stated' when the manual gives a check or remedy; 'not_stated' when a search of the manual finds none; 'not_in_entry' when the entry that names the cause gives none and the rest of the manual was not searched.

properties.name: entry_status
properties.description: 'none_in_manual' when the manual gives no symptom or code that leads to the cause.

properties.name: source_reference
properties.description: Page and section of the manual where the item is written.

nodes.name: CorrectiveAction
nodes.description: An action, procedure, or remediation step intended to resolve a failure mode. A corrective action may be an operational procedure the technician performs (action_kind 'procedure') or a documented escalation the manual prescribes when it provides no on-site fix, e.g. 'contact your factory outlet / dealer / service' (action_kind 'escalation').

properties.name: expected_result
properties.description: Normal value or result of a check, as the manual gives it.

nodes.name: ErrorCode
nodes.description: A machine-generated error code or alert code produced by the asset and linked to troubleshooting knowledge.

properties.name: diagnosis_status
properties.description: 'not_stated' when the manual gives the code without a cause or a remedy.

properties.name: source_reference
properties.description: Page and section of the manual where the item is written.

relations.name: HAS_COMPONENT
relations.description: The asset includes the specified component.

relations.name: MAY_INDICATE
relations.description: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode.

relations.name: AFFECTS
relations.description: The failure mode affects the specified component.

relations.name: RESOLVED_BY
relations.description: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action.

relations.name: GENERATES_ERROR
relations.description: The asset may generate the specified error code.

relations.name: INDICATES
relations.description: The error code indicates the specified failure mode.

relations.name: PART_OF
relations.description: The component belongs to the specified assembly or subsystem.
relations.rationale: Gives the component hierarchy read from parts lists and assembly sections, so that a fault on a part is found from its assembly.

relations.name: ACTS_ON
relations.description: The action or check is performed on the specified component.
relations.rationale: Joins remedies and checks to the part they work on; a component test with expected values needs no invented symptom.

relations.name: OBSERVED_ON
relations.description: The symptom is observed on the specified component.
relations.rationale: Lets a diagnosis start from the part where the problem shows.

relations.name: ADDRESSED_BY
relations.description: The manual prescribes the action or check directly for the symptom, without naming a cause.
relations.rationale: Replaces placeholder causes ('Unspecified cause of ...') that existed only as bridges.

relations.name: CLEARED_BY
relations.description: The manual prescribes the action or check directly for the error code, without naming a cause.
relations.rationale: Same reason as ADDRESSED_BY, for codes.
